description: National Gem and Jewellery Authority - National Gem and Jewellery (Gem Mining Licence) Regulations 2020.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No. 50 of 1993. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing new regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
